Tim, saw Prove launch the unified Identity Platform and line up partnerships with authID, Trinsic, and Spinwheel.

A platform launch and a wave of partners usually mean more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Tim, quick follow-up for Prove.

With the platform launch driving new demand, the question is how many meetings the team needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of target, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.

Tim, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
